name: Niyam Raja
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Niyam Raja negotiates the place of an upland crown in the emerging southern polity. Royal authority depends on retaining a say over quarry concessions and defending the springs on which upland settlements depend. The University register proposes a connection to Vijayan Watershed Compact. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
